answer: Witnessed physical-space check: each identity must periodically submit a signed reading from a hardware sensor that measures a property only real occupancy produces, such as ambient vibration plus thermal drift, hashed through a rotating prism of challenge values. The operator must physically place the device in a distinct occupied location each dawn; duplicates fail cross-checks. A meadow site seeds daily nonces. Cost: one device and real room per identity, plus daily relocation labor, so faking N identities needs N separate physical spaces and N times the manual effort.
